purpose: Defines the minimum machine-checkable actor, use-case, scenario, and requirement traceability contract for a future MVP use-case model. It does not create a Dopis use-case inventory or grant implementation authority.

actors.rule: Actors are human roles or genuinely external systems; a device alone is not an actor.

rules: Every use case has at least one PRIMARY actor link.
Every use case has at least one BEHAVIOR requirement link.
Requirement identifiers resolve to the accepted requirements registry and occur at most once per use case.
Every use case has exactly one MAIN scenario.
Scenario requirement identifiers resolve and are a subset of their parent use case requirement links.
Scenario steps describe observable behavior and do not prescribe UI design, classes, APIs, database structure, or architecture.
Use cases refine requirements; they do not own requirements or imply implementation readiness.

traceability.future_node_index: DOPIS_TRACEABILITY_MATRIX.json future_nodes.use_cases is an exact validator-recomputed index of model use-case IDs.
